title: DocumentUpdateInput
description: Full metadata edit. Both String fields are required; content, identity, digest, size and creation instant cannot be edited.

name.description: Display name, trimmed before persistence; nonblank, at most 200 characters. No path separators, C0/C1 controls, line/paragraph separators, or dot-only path components. It is never a filesystem path.

reservationId.description: Opaque ID of an existing reservation in the same trip, or empty to leave the document unlinked. A reservation deleted later unlinks documents without deleting their bytes.
